role: fresh independent reviewer; zero implementation authorship

review_package.note: Exact implementation commit, not a moving BASE..HEAD range. Later unrelated HEAD changes were excluded.

evidence: The original mismatch is established by .research/resource-guard-semantics.json and EXT-D-0132: a single retained CPU-only RESOURCE_WATCH_UNSAFE from run37234434600 was permanently refused by the old native boundary before a second watch, while the wrapper finalized child_failed/resourceInvalid=false. This does not prove that the physical spike recovered.

Current scripts/stabilization-resource-cpu.mjs:1-57 owns CPU timing: first CPU-only bad is pending, two consecutive bad are terminal unsafe, three consecutive reason-free watches recover, another bad resets the healthy count, and a monotonic episode deadline is derived from existing policy knobs.

Current scripts/stabilization-resource.mjs:752-818 publishes pending/recovered/unsafe states, then writes hold and stop markers and invokes the existing owned group stop for confirmed unsafe or expiry. Non-CPU and measurement failures take the immediate unsafe path. Child/operator exit while pending sets resourceInvalid at lines 711-733; final verdict includes unresolved pending at lines 883-899.

Current tests/browser/native-resource-boundary.mjs:34-158 retains owner, stop, hold, legacy unsafe and freshness refusals; pending prevents new actions, explicit recovered plus a fresh sample permits one. awaitNativeResourceHealth at lines 170-229 waits for guard evidence with a monotonic bound and leaves later calls independent.

The focused node --test command passed 23/23. The resource-policy.json numeric thresholds and preflight sampling were unchanged in the exact commit; the one-heavy lease and cleanup code were not changed.
limitations: No native/browser run was authorized in this lane. No physical CPU recovery, product acceptance, or finalized native journal is verified here.
The source path for pending child exit and immediate non-CPU refusal is visible, but the focused suite does not drive those transitions through the live wrapper loop; see Verdict B.

finding.title: The regression does not force the production watch-to-journal wiring
finding.reproduction: In a TemporaryDirectory scratch copy of scripts/, tests/browser/, and resource-policy.json, replace the unique wrapper expression ? 'RESOURCE_CPU_PENDING' in scripts/stabilization-resource.mjs:767 with ? 'RESOURCE_WATCH_HEALTHY'. Run node --test on tests/browser/resource-cpu-confirmation.test.mjs, tests/browser/native-resource-boundary.test.mjs, scripts/test-stabilization-resource-journal.mjs, and scripts/test-stabilization-resource-process.mjs in that copy. Actual: 23/23 pass, exit 0. The shared source was not modified.
finding.why_it_matters: The mutant mispublishes the first CPU-only bad watch as healthy. Since the native boundary scans pending/unsafe codes and then selects a prior fresh healthy event, an action can proceed during the unconfirmed candidate. The new test instead calls cpuEpisode.observe and manually emits the expected codes at tests/browser/resource-cpu-confirmation.test.mjs:59 and 92-97. No focused test executes the wrapper branch at scripts/stabilization-resource.mjs:765-778 under CPU load.
finding.minimum_repair: Add one controlled scratch guard subprocess case with real wrapper loop, journal writer, and native boundary. Inject only measurement/clock dependencies beneath the wrapper, then assert first CPU-only bad yields RESOURCE_CPU_PENDING and zero actions, three full healthy watches yield RESOURCE_CPU_RECOVERED and one later action, and a second bad or pending child exit yields invalid final evidence and owned stop/cleanup. Run the scratch mutation above as RED against that case, restore it, then run GREEN. Keep native confirmation as the next separate gate.

verdict_B_quality.other_checks: No new parallel CPU classifier, compatibility shim, numeric threshold change, historical unsafe reinterpretation, or weakened legacy unsafe refusal was found. The existing unit test of cpuEpisode and manual journal/boundary replay are useful seam checks but cannot establish production wrapper wiring.

readiness: Do not treat this source review or green focused suite as native clearance yet. Close Verdict B with a forcing wrapper integration case and fresh re-review; then root may run one guarded native confirmation and judge its completed journal and actual product evidence.
verification: Read-only exact-commit diff and source census; focused 23/23; one isolated scratch mutation also 23/23; no product source edit, native launch, build, workflow or release.
